summary.title: Professional Skills
summary.content:
• Large Language Models: In-depth understanding of the fundamental principles and applications of Transformer series models such as BERT and GPT; proficient in fine-tuning Qwen series models (SFT/LoRA/DeepSpeed); familiar with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, OpenManaus, Nemo Guardrails for developing RAG and Agent systems.

  • Machine Learning: Solid grasp of common machine learning model fundamentals; proficient in the principles and hyperparameter tuning of ensemble models such as XGBoost, LightGBM, RF; skilled in using common tools like pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.

  • Others: Familiar with designing detection architectures for prompt jailbreak and injection in the LLM security domain. Experience in building intelligent SOC systems.

  • CET6

items.company: Shanghai Doushare Information Technology Co., Ltd. (FreeBuf & VulBox)
items.description:
• Led the security protection project for large model systems. Implemented detection solutions for security risks and privacy data leakage in model input and output content.

  • Led the intelligent vulnerability reproduction agent project. Achieved automated reproduction and report generation for SQL injection reports in VulBox.

  • Led the fine-tuning project for cybersecurity domain-specific models. Completed training data cleaning, SFT data construction, fine-tuning based on Qwen and Pangu series models, and PPO alignment.

  • Led the SOC intelligent RAG assistant project. Customized RAG assistants across multiple projects, supporting retrieval and Q&A from various data sources.

  • Participated in optimizing traffic detection models.

items.name: Multi-Agent Self-Optimizing Penetration Testing System
items.description:
Designed and implemented a multi-agent security testing framework supporting agents like root, recon, exploit, using a Hybrid Agent Teams + Delegation multi-agent structure.

  • Designed and implemented a multi-agent security testing framework with Hybrid Agent Teams + Delegation structure.

  • Built a multi-level Memory structure to optimize the balance between token consumption and known information for sub-agents during runtime.

  • Resolved issues such as repeated tool calls among multi-level agents, infinite task loops, and premature task termination due to incorrect tool calls.

  • Implemented log replay for failed tasks, minimizing modifications to relevant skill content to achieve system self-optimization.

items.name: LLM Security Computing Cloud
items.description:
Built a security guardrail for large language models. Supports both online cloud and on-premises deployment. Used for input and output control of enterprise LLM applications, including detection of prompt jailbreak, prompt injection, sensitive content identification, and specific content filtering.

  • Constructed the detection architecture and workflow, compared capabilities of LLM security platforms or models like Nvidia NeMo, Gemma Shield, Llama Guard.

  • Fine-tuned Prompt injection & jailbreak detection models (binary and three-class classification) based on mDeBERTa. Annotated 50k+ Chinese data. F1-score improved by 0.21.

  • Fine-tuned Prompt content safety detection models based on Qwen3 0.6B, 1.7B, 8B. Annotated 80k Chinese data. Performance improved by 27% compared to the base model.

  • Calculated perplexity based on Qwen1.7B model, used heuristic methods to detect Prompt jailbreak detection models. Annotated 10k Chinese data, performance improved by 14% compared to the base model.

  • Privacy data identification, constructed 10k Chinese data to train and optimize NER model. TPS improved.

  • RAG factual relevance detection.

  • Evaluated jailbreak risk of Qwen models using different jailbreak methods, constructed detection set using neural network testing approach.

items.name: Automated Vulnerability Report Reproduction
items.description:
Built an agent system to automatically reproduce vulnerabilities based on vulnerability report content. The vulnerabilities are from VulBox reports. Based on key information in the report such as vulnerability category, version, and reproduction logic, designed an automated reproduction system to replicate the operational steps in the report.

  • Constructed a human-in-the-loop agent architecture, including five modules: controller, events, session, agent, tracer.

  • Built a report content parsing and key entity extraction agent to extract topic information. Validated through a rationality analysis model.

  • Built an automated sqlmap reproduction tool, using intent recognition and few-shot methods to automate the sqlmap tool.

  • Built an app control tool for WeChat mini-programs and official accounts, based on OmniParser + pyautogui to automate input and click processes.

  • Optimized recognition accuracy in OmniParser's operation boxes, improving accuracy by 15% while reducing token consumption by 70%.

items.name: Cybersecurity Domain-Specific Model
items.description:
Continued pre-training and fine-tuning on security domain data across models of different sizes to build a security domain-specific model, mainly focused on vulnerabilities.

  • Processed continued pre-training data, built an 80b token training dataset, used ftfy to fix data encoding, and applied dynamic re-weighting for data sampling.

  • Scored and annotated vulnerability reports, used 5k SFT data for fine-tuning combined with few-shot to achieve scoring and issue annotation for VulBox reports.

  • Optimized and orchestrated vulnerability report reproduction steps, achieving core step re-orchestration.

  • Constructed SFT data. Used DeepSpeed for full-parameter fine-tuning of the continued pre-trained model, and LoRA for fine-tuning vulnerability-related models.

  • Fine-tuned multimodal large models based on Qwen2.5-VL to address the issue of key information contained in images within vulnerability reports.

items.name: SOC Platform Q&A System
items.description:
Integrated large model intelligent Q&A into the SOC platform. Built a RAG Q&A system based on platform situational awareness, threat alerts, and local enterprise knowledge base.

  • Customized corpus collection and organization, used small models to build multi-level indices for the corpus.

  • Corpus segmentation, used label + similarity hybrid recall method for data query and re-ranking. Recall rate improved by 5%.

  • Built Faiss vector database.

  • Designed NL2SQL prompts based on database table structure and similar question hit jump functionality. Reduced token consumption for repeated questions, improved SQL query accuracy and efficiency.

  • Post-processing of Q&A results, privacy data filtering, answer consistency detection.

items.name: Automated Vulnerability Intelligence Data Completion
items.description:
Analyzed content in intelligence data, built a vector database for quick lookup of similar content such as version numbers and CVE IDs.

  • Automatically extracted CPE fields from MySQL, vectorized after JSON formatting, built Milvus vector database for fast retrieval.

  • Used Qwen model to parse vulnerability intelligence data, extracted strings conforming to CPE format, converted to JSON objects, vectorized, and queried in Milvus.

  • Qwen analyzed vulnerability description text and extracted intelligence text. Extracted standardized strings.

  • Returned candidate CPEs based on vector retrieval, combined with large model extraction of version constraints for precise filtering.

items.name: Malicious Encrypted Traffic Detection and Family Identification
items.description:
Detected malicious encrypted traffic within time windows using a multi-model voting mechanism, and performed multi-classification of malicious families.

  • Collected open-source malicious encrypted samples and self-developed sandbox samples, completed data cleaning and standardization.

  • Extracted multi-dimensional features (e.g., TLS fingerprint, DNS behavior, traffic statistics), built models like LightGBM, XGBoost, RandomForest.

  • Fused prediction results from multiple models to form a voting mechanism, improving malicious traffic detection accuracy.

  • Optimized model inference speed, designed post-processing logic to filter false positives, improving actual detection rate.

  • Used intelligence sources for cross-validation to enhance model generalization.

  • Built XGBoost multi-classification model covering 33 family categories.

items.name: DGA Traffic Detection
items.description:
Built DGA domain binary and multi-classification models, designed a false positive reduction system for online environments. Optimized detection capability for word-type family domains.

  • Extracted structural, statistical, and linguistic features to build DGA identification models, fused multiple models to build a Stacking ensemble classifier.

  • Designed word list collision and voting mechanisms for family identification, combined static analysis and behavior analysis to improve accuracy.

  • Introduced offline correlation analysis based on IP and domain names to accurately identify active botnets behind Fast-Flux strategies, effectively reducing false positive rates.

  • Optimized word list content for word-type domains, combined with BERT model for semantic detection.
